claim: The versioned Great Graph contains 253 nodes and 522 edges across eight strata, with 35 cross-stratum edges, 20 self-loops, and 33 negative edges.
permitted_wording: The current versioned artifact has this census.
prohibited_inference: The census proves psychological truth or clinical validity.

claim: The current graph implementation satisfies all five registered structural axiom tests and has zero encapsulation violations.
permitted_wording: The implementation passes its declared formal tests.
prohibited_inference: All possible semantic contradictions have been eliminated.

claim: A person, an observation, a latent state, a standing condition, a theory prior, a personalized temporal operator, a context input, and a control input are distinct typed objects.
permitted_wording: The application protocol requires these separations.
prohibited_inference: The latent objects are identifiable from any available data.

claim: Identical versioned admissible inputs and fixed model state return identical numerical output.
permitted_wording: The computational layer is deterministic under the frozen contract.
prohibited_inference: Human meaning, values, or clinical judgment are deterministic.

claim: The masked GAT improves edge RMSE, person-deviation correlation, and spectral-radius error over all Step-4 baselines in 12/12 uploaded synthetic benchmark cells.
permitted_wording: The estimator recovers these properties within the simulator family.

claim: The temporal transformer beats persistence at one-step forecasting in all three uploaded synthetic populations.
source_ids: TRF013; TRF016; TRF030; fresh/archived checkpoint evaluation
permitted_wording: The forecaster beats persistence in-family on held-out simulated persons.
prohibited_inference: It is clinically calibrated or prognostic.

permitted_wording: Internal event definitions are learnable under simulator assumptions.
prohibited_inference: A clinical relapse alarm is validated.

claim: IPIP domain reliability ranges from .817 to .905 in 619,150 records.
permitted_wording: This archive supports reliable five-domain PER scoring.
prohibited_inference: Reliability establishes validity, causality, or a health scalar.

claim: Five varimax components recover the intended primary domain for 25 of 30 IPIP facets.
permitted_wording: Most, but not all, facet primary loadings align with the intended domain.

claim: A transparent 20-item ME load correlates with concurrent 7-day weekly depression in the single-person ESM archive (rho=.625; circular-block interval approximately [.403,.800]; n=27 anchors).
permitted_wording: The derived ME load has concurrent validity evidence in this person.
prohibited_inference: Population validity, diagnosis, or causal direction.

claim: The 21-day AR(1) and variance indicators predict next-week depression change in the single-person archive.
permitted_wording: Neither indicator was supported in this analysis; intervals include zero.
prohibited_inference: Critical slowing down is universally absent or present.

claim: The expanding-window ridge model improves on persistence in the single-person archive.
permitted_wording: The candidate model loses to persistence on MAE and RMSE.
prohibited_inference: No richer real-data model can work.

claim: The complete UPG can diagnose mental disorders.
permitted_wording: UPG may organize hypotheses and established diagnostic evidence; formal diagnostic performance remains untested.

claim: UPG-guided treatment improves outcomes or cures disorders.
permitted_wording: Clinical effectiveness and cure claims require prospective comparative trials and durable outcomes.

claim: The UPG can presently serve as a transparent collaborative formulation and research protocol when outputs are restricted by data sufficiency.
permitted_wording: The protocol can structure assessment, hypotheses, provenance, and monitoring.

claim: Psychotherapy adverse effects and client-reported negative experiences must be actively monitored.
permitted_wording: Every intervention plan includes benefit, burden, deterioration, and adverse-experience monitoring.
prohibited_inference: A graph score replaces clinical safety procedures.

claim: Any clinical software implementation requires lifecycle governance, human-factor evaluation, subgroup calibration, monitoring, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory review.
permitted_wording: These controls define the translation pathway.
prohibited_inference: Current research code is cleared or compliant.

claim: All-age or universal scope is an empirical transportability claim, not an axiomatically guaranteed property.
permitted_wording: Use age-, language-, culture-, disability-, and neurotype-appropriate measurement and test invariance/calibration.
prohibited_inference: One model version is valid for every population.

claim: Gödel's incompleteness theorems add no patient-level diagnostic or treatment rule in Batch K.
permitted_wording: The operational consequence is a versioned open theory that can return unknown.
prohibited_inference: Individual uncertainty is proved by Gödel.
